title: Map GitHub project to repository and automate sync
description: Design and implement mapping between the GitHub project at https://github.com/tyttoot/platform.git and this local repository. Include plan for webhooks, CI checks, issue→task sync, and PR templates.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A design doc describing mapping and automation exists (PR or doc entry)
Minimal automation plan for webhooks and issue/task sync is defined
PR template and issue template created in repo root (or documented)
Owner/steps documented for connecting GitHub Project board and syncing tasks

subtasks.text: Draft design: goals, scope, data flows (GitHub project → repo)
List required GitHub permissions/webhook events and CI interactions
Create PR/Issue templates and sample automation scripts

notes: Start by reviewing existing release and push scripts (scripts/push_to_git.sh, scripts/doc_version.sh) and platform rules. Coordinate with repo owner to add webhooks.
